newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Standard Chartered M.L. dips 4.31 pct.
newsitem.headline: Standard Chartered M.L. dips 4.31 pct.

text.p: The Standard Chartered Mercantile Leasing Company's 10-rupee stock fell 0.90 rupee, or 4.31 percent, to 20, on Friday on selling pressure at the Karachi Stock Exchange.
One dealer said the stock fell after the Standard Chartered Group in Pakistan said it would sell its shares in the company to Saudi Pak Industrial and Agricultural Investment Co Ltd.
Saudi Pak is a joint venture between the governments of Saudi Arabia and Pakistan and its chairman is nominated by the government of Saudi Arabia.
